curatedMovie.curiosityHook: As his partner's fragile state begins to fracture their shared life, can his devotion keep her grounded?
curatedMovie.description: An aspiring novelist and handyman tries to support his younger girlfriend as her condition worsens.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: Heavy, slow-paced French romance demanding engaged attention for its raw emotional weight.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: This drama-romance centers a strained relationship through one man’s effort to support his younger girlfriend.
